mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM vi_payment_order p JOIN ( SELECT MIN(id) id FROM vi_payment_order WHERE payment_method = 'WECHAT' GROUP BY merchant_profile_id, mchid, app_id ) r ON r.id = p.id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT order_id FROM vi_payment_order WHERE status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND (next_query_at IS NULL OR next_query_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (payment_method = 'WECHAT' OR expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) OR close_requested_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_query_at, expires_at), id LIMIT 25
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_payment_order SET next_query_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND (next_query_at IS NULL OR next_query_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET close_requested_at = COALESCE(close_requested_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND paid_fen = 0

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET status = 'PENDING', next_query_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND paid_fen = 0

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET status = 'UNKNOWN', next_query_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND paid_fen = 0

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET status = 'SUCCESS', transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_fen = total_fen, paid_at = #{paidAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, capacity_resolution =
'MANUAL_CONFLICT' 'HELD' , next_query_at = NULL, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND paid_fen = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','CLOSED')

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', capacity_resolution = 'RELEASED', next_query_at = NULL, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND paid_fen = 0
UPDATE vi_order SET fulfillment_status = #{state}, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND fulfillment_status = 'PENDING_PAY'
mapper.select: SELECT id, slot_id, quantity, status FROM vi_quota_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY slot_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_quota_slot SET held_quota = held_quota-#{quantity}, confirmed_quota = confirmed_quota+#{quantity}, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{slotId} AND held_quota >= #{quantity}

UPDATE vi_quota_reservation SET status = #{state}, expires_at = NULL, released_at = CASE WHEN #{state} = 'RELEASED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'HELD'
mapper.select: SELECT trade_no, event_type, verified_digest FROM vi_channel_event WHERE provider = #{provider} AND event_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_channel_event(provider, event_key, trade_no, event_type, verified_digest, processed_at) VALUES(#{provider},#{key},#{trade},#{type},#{digest}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, p.order_id FROM vi_refund_order r JOIN vi_payment_order p ON p.id = r.payment_id WHERE r.out_refund_no = #{no} AND r.payment_method = 'WECHAT' AND r.execution_mode = 'WECHAT_API'
SELECT * FROM vi_refund_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_refund_order SET status = 'SUCCESS', channel_refund_id = #{channelId}, success_at = #{at,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, next_query_at = NULL, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN','ABNORMAL')
UPDATE vi_refund_order SET status = #{state}, version = version+1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN','ABNORMAL')
